learning_outcomes.text: Students are familiar with the basic concepts of mechanics of solid and liquid bodies in a uniform representation.

Students are able to apply the principles of mechanics to fundamental model problems of statics and possess the qualification for developing appropriate (computer-friendly) formulations and computational models.

syllabus_topics: Force and groups of forces and their reduction
Introduction to the statics of line structures and fluids
Point kinematics and kinematics of rigid bodies
Accompanying exercises for the lecture: Demonstration of calculation and practice of independent solving of basic problems in statics and kinematics
